metadata.title: CGE-P HIPAA-minimum control selection (Acme Health Patient Intake API)
metadata.remarks: Selects the NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls that back the HIPAA Security Rule citations in component-definition.json. There is no NIST-published HIPAA OSCAL catalog, so the primary framework (HIPAA, cited via SP 800-66 Rev. 2 in the component) is realised here through its 800-53 control equivalents. See README.md in this directory for the HIPAA -> 800-53 crosswalk.
